}}'''Vanora Carridin''' was [[Jaichim Carridin]]'s favorite sister.{{ref/book|c|Vanora Carridin}} She was good-natured and very skilled with horses.{{ref/book|7|15}}
==History==
She liked to ride alone in the forest beyond Carmera.{{ref/book|4|38}}

Jaichim Carridin told [[Liandrin Guirale]] where Vanora could be found in the hope that he would be given more time to kill Rand.{{ref/book|4|38}}

She was given to [[Fades]] and [[Trollocs]] by [[Sammael]] as punishment for Carridin's failures.{{ref/book|7|15}}
